latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of insforge-cli, a command-line tool for managing InsForge Backend-as-a-Service projects.

- Provides authentication, project setup/link, and user/project status commands.
- Manages databases (queries, RPC, schema inspection, import/export), edge functions (deploy, invoke), and storage (buckets, file upload/download).
- Handles deployments, secrets management (soft delete, expired, reserved), and scheduled tasks (cron jobs).
- Includes built-in logs fetching for backend/services and project documentation lookup.
- Supports per-command structure, environment variable overrides, and workflow best practices in documentation.
